newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BULGARIA, March 24 - Varna - East - 2 Vessels loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 5 awaiting orders. West - 2 Vessels loading at berth. Bouas - East - 24 Vessels due, 8 loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 6 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 under repair. West - 2 Vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth. 1 Tanker loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth. Bourgas - 19 Vessels operating of which 12 loading, 1 chemicals, 3 fertiliser, 1 steel plates, 1 wood, 3 metal, 1 clinker, 1 general, 1 cotton/corn. 6 Discharging, 1 coal, 1 lead/zinc, 1 rails, 2 oil products1 container vessel, 1 empty vessel. 8 Vessels waiting in roads of which 7 to load, 1 empty, 1 wood, 1 fertiliser, 1 benzene, 1 cargo not nominated, 1 under repair. 24 Vessels due of which 14 to load, 4 steel, 1 chemicals, 1 gasoline, 1 fertiliser, 1 copper, 1 clinker, 1 general/containers, 1 metal, 1 general, 1 concentrate, 1 bentonite. 8 To discharge, 2 salt, 1 coils, 2 zinc concentrates, 3 iron ore,

CROATIA, March 24 - Rijeka - Four vessels due, delays expected. 2 Vessels anchored, 4 under repair/drydock. Split - One vessel discharging at berth. Ploce - Two vessels discharging at berth. Pula, Rasa, Zadar, Sibenik, Dubrovnik - No vessels.

ESTONIA - March 24 - Tallinn - City port - No vessels due. 3 Loading at berth, 1 steel billets, 2 fertiliser. 1 Vessel discharging sugar at berth, 1 liner vessel. Kopli - 8 Vessels due. Loading at berth, 1 sawn timber, 2 fertiliser, 1 non-ferrous metals, 1 vessel discharging fish at berth. Parnu - 5 Vessels due. Loading at berth, 3 timber, 3 briquettes, 3 peat. Muuga - 5 Vessels due. Loading at berth, 4 fuel oil, 2 timber, 1 seeds, 2 general cargo, 1 other vessel. Discharging at berth, 1 poultry, 1 paper, 2 grain, 2 general cargo, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge.

ITALY, March 25 - Naples - One gas tanker to berth 26/3, 2 bulk carriers, the first to berth 25/3, the second within the next few days. Gaeta, Salerno - No vessels in roads. Multedo oil port - From 1/4 the sea platform (crude discharge) will be under maintenance for about 30 working days. No vessels in roads, no delays, 1 vessel berthed. Genoa commercial port - No vessels in roads, no delays. 32 Vessels berthed, 4 in drydock. Savona, Vado Ligure, Gaeta, Naples, Salerno, Augusta, Syracuse, Palermo, Venice, Ancona, Falconara - No vessels in roads, no delays. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays. 5 Vessels berthed, 5 under repair. Leghorn - Eight vessels in roads, no delays, 34 vessels berthed. Civitavecchia - One vessel in roads. Sarroch - Two vessels in roads, 5 berthed. Taranto - One vessel in roads. Ravenna - 12 Vessels in roads. Trieste - Six vessels in roads, some congestion at Siot,Tal oil terminal.

LATVIA, March 25 - Ventspils - Six vessels operating of which 1 alumina loader, 1 zinc loader, 1 steel billets loader, 1 beer discharger, 1 sugar discharger/loader, 1 fish discharger. No delays, 9 vessels due. Riga - 25 Vessels in port of which 22 operating, 5 timber, 1 cotton, 2 containers, 2 tankers, 2 metal, 1 fertiliser, 4 frozen food, 3 fish, 2 container dischargers. 3 Awaiting operations, no delays, 20 vessels due. Liepaja - Seven vessels operating, no delays, 3 vessels due.

LITHUANIA, March 25 - Klaipeda - Vessels loading in port, 1 scrap, 2 fertiliser, 1 metal, 3 timber, 3 steel coils. Discharging, 3 fish, 1 citrus fruit, 1 each general cargo, grain, sugar. 1 Vessel loading/discharging. 5 Vessels in roads, 25 due.

POLAND, March 25 - Szczecin - 73 Vessels due, delays expected. 41 Vessels loading at berth, 26 discharging at berth. 6 Vessels under repair/drydock. Gdynia - Eight vessels loading at berth (5 general cargo, 2 bulk, 1 coal). 3 Discharging at berth (2 general cargo, 1 grain), 3 under repair, 29 due. Gdansk - Two vessels awaiting turn of which 1 bulk, 1 coal. 9 Vessels loading at berth (3 bulk, 3 general cargo, 2 coal, 1 grain). 2 Bulk discharging at berth, 2 under repair/drydock, 24 due.

PORTUGAL, March 25 - Lisbon - A pilot strike commenced on 24/3 and expected to last until 28/3. The strike stops all vessels from entering/leaving the port. The strike schedule is as follows, 24/3 (0000 to 2400 hrs), 25/3 (0000 to 1200 hrs), 26/3 (0000 to 1200 hrs), 27/3 (1200 to 2400 hrs), 28/3 (0000 to 1200 hrs). 34 Vessels due, 76 in port. 1 Loading at berth, 15 unloading at berth, 7 loading/unloading at berth, 2 loading at anchorage, 1 bunkering. 20 Vessels in repair/dry-dock, 5 awaiting orders, 23 miscellaneous craft.

Leixoes - The port is partially closed due to pilots strike. Vessels operating, 7 general cargo, 3 container vessels. Awaiting berth, 1 container, 3 general cargo vessels totalling 22,428 dwt (handy size). Places vacant, 4 piers with cranes, 3 without cranes. Sines - Vessels operating, 1 discharging crude, 1 each loading metallic structures, propylene. 2 Vessels waiting to load of which 1 fuel oil, 1 butane/propane, 2 due to load of which 1 butadiene, 1 gasoil. Setubal - Five vessels loading at berth, 8 discharging at berth, 6 under repair/drydock. Vessels due, 8 for discharging, 4 for loading, 1 for repair/drydock.

ROMANIA, March 24 - Constantza - 20 Vessels operating of which 6 generals, 8 bulkers, 3 bagged chemicals, 1 tanker, 1 bagged cement, 1 container vessel. 2 Vessels waiting in roads of which 1 bulker, 1 tanker. Constantza Sud (Agea) - One general loading. Mangalia - No vessels. Midia - Five vessels loading livestock.

RUSSIA, March 24 - BALTIC PORTS - St. Petersburg - 11 Vessels operating of which loading, 1 non-ferrous, 3 fertiliser, 1 pipes, 2 metal, 1 general cargo. Discharging, 2 frozen chicken, 1 container vessel. 9 Vessels awaiting operations, 9 due. March 25 - Kaliningrad - 16 Vessels operating of which 5 urea loaders, 1 ferrous loader, 3 alumina loaders, 1 chemical cargo loader, 1 paper loader, 1 container loader, 2 coke loaders, 1 container discharger. No delays, 2 vessels due. Vyborg - Three vessels in port of which 2 operating, 1 awaiting operations, no delays, 3 vessels due.

BLACK SEA - Novorossiysk - March 17 to 24 - 22 Vessels operating of which 13 loading, 2 scrap, 4 steel, 1 coal, 1 cast iron, 1 zinc, 1 saltpetre, 1 barley, 1 molasses, 1 bulk urea. 9 Discharging, 1 rice, 2 various, 4 citrus, 1 barytes, 1 containers. 21 Vessels waiting in roads of which 8 to load, 1 scrap, 4 steel, 1 copper, 2 seeds. 13 To discharge, 5 bulk sugar, 3 rice, 1 bagged rice, 3 citrus, 1 bagged beans. 44 Vessels due, 28 to load of which 4 scrap, 5 coal, 11 steel, 2 copper, 2 aluminium, 1 zinc, 1 bulk cement, 1 paper, 1 saltpetre. 14 To discharge, 1 bulk maize, 3 bulk sugar, 1 rice, 3 citrus, 1 zinc concentrates, 1 equipment, 1 cement, 2 luggage, 1 containers, 1 containers/citrus. 2 To discharge/load, 1 containers, 1 cars. Oil terminal - March 24 - 2 Vessels berthed, 6 tankers waiting in roads, 9 tankers due to load.

March 25 - FAR EAST - Vladivostok - 16 Vessels in port of which 1 pax. 7 Vessels loading (4 metal, 2 timber, 1 general cargo), 1 reefer discharging, 7 vessels waiting. Nakhodka - 10 Vessels in port of which 6 loading (3 metal, 3 timber, 5 vessels waiting. Vostochniy - Six vessels in port of which 4 loading (2 timber, 1 coal, 1 container), 2 waiting. Posyet, Zarubino - No vesels in ports. No delays or congestion in ports.

NORTHERN BASIN - Murmansk - Six vessels operating of which 2 alumina, 1 steel, 1 apatite, 1 scrap, 1 non-ferrous metals, 1 apatite loader, 4 alumina dischargers awaiting berth. 6 Vessels due during the week of which 4 loaders (1 non-ferrous metals, 1 coal, 2 apatite), 2 cabotage dischargers.

SLOVENIA, March 24 - Koper - 10 Vessels berthed of which 2 containers loading/discharging, 2 general cargo loading sawn timber, paper, steel. 2 Bulk carriers discharging coal, alumina, 1 bulk carrier loading coal. 1 Ferry loading/discharging, 1 car carrier loading/discharging cars, 1 reefer discharging bananas. 15 Vessels due during next 2 days of which 4 containers to load/discharge, 2 car carriers to load cars, 1 tanker to discharge gasoline, 2 livestock to load bulls, 3 general cargo to load sawn timber, kaoline in bags, 1 reef to discharge bananas, 2 bulk carriers to discharge alumina, tin. No delays expected in port.

SPAIN, March 25 - Santander - Vessels loading, 1 sugar, 2 sodium phosphate, 1 soda. Unloading, 1 each scrap, coal, butadiene, steel pipes, pig iron, chemical products. No vessels anchored, no delays expected. Cadiz - 18 Vessels operating of which 3 ro-ro, 2 semolina, 2 shipbuilding material, 1 salt, 2 wheat, 1 sand, 1 clay, 6 under repair, no delays. Bilbao - 10 Vessels discharging, 5 loading, 9 loading/discharging. Petronor refinery on strike from 21/3 to 28/3. Aviles - Seven vessels in port of which 3 loading (1 cement, 2 steel products). 4 Discharging (1 scrap, 2 steel products, 1 dunite). Gijon - Four vessels in port of which 1 loading cement, 3 discharging iron ore, cement and fuel oil, no delays or congestion.

Sagunto - 26 Vessels operating of which 3 ro-ro discharging/loading general cargo, 1 vessel discharging fresh fruit pallets, 16 discharging steel products, 1 each discharging bulk ammonia, timber, coal, 1 loading bulk fertiliser, 2 loading cement. No vessels outside commercial wharf, no berthing delays.

TURKEY, March 25 - Iskenderun - Discharging in port, 1 anthracite, 2 ore. Sariseki - Discharging, 3 fertiliser, 1 vessel anchored. Yazicilar - One building iron loading, 1 scrap iron discharging. Ekinciler - One building iron loading, 2 scrap iron discharging, 1 vessel anchored. Isdemir - One building iron loading, 2 coal discharging. Toros - One fertiliser discharging, 1 vessel anchored. Botas (Ceyhan) - One vessel anchored. Mersin - Eight vessels awaiting orders. 19 Vessels operating of which loading, 1 chrome ore, 1 clinker, 1 pumice stone, 1 legumes, 2 livestock, 2 cement. Discharging, 1 iron, soda, 1 sunflower, 1 bulk vegetable oil, 1 general cargo. Loading/discharging, 2 vehicles, 1 container, 1 container/wool/chick peas, 1 container/beer, 1 pumice stone/empty boxes. Free zone piers - 1 Chrome and 1 rice loading. Seka - No vessels. Istanbul - Haydarpasa - 5 Vessels operating of which 1 container, 3 dry cargo, 1 ro-ro, no berthing delays. Galata - 9 Cargo/passenger vessels operating, port congested.

UKRAINE, March 24 - Mariupol - Five vessels operating of which 4 loading, 2 sulphur, 1 mop, 1 containers. 1 Loading/discharging fire clay,alumina. 3 Waiting in roads for loading. 24 Vessels due of which 20 to load, 5 steel products, 3 sulphur, 3 coal, 3 sunflower seeds, 2 pig iron, 1 map, 2 fire clay, 1 slabs/pig iron/cuprum slabs. 1 To load/discharge steel coils/chrome ore, 3 to discharge containers. Odessa - 20 Vessels operating of which 6 loading, 1 oil, 1 metal, 1 sunflower seeds, 1 sugar, 1 fertiliser, 1 chemicals. 1 Discharging/loading containers, 1 each discharging gasoil, citrus, tea, 7 under repair. 1 Passenger and 1 navy vessel, 1 change of crew. 6 Vessels waiting in roads of which 4 to load, 2 sunflower seeds, 1 peas, 1 fuel oil, 1 waiting. 20 Vessels due of which 14 to load, 6 to discharge.

Mariupol - Loading at berth, 1 fertiliser, 2 sulphur, 1 containers, 1 sunflower seeds discharging at berth. 1 Vessel under repair/drydock, 3 waiting at anchorage to load (2 sulphur, 1 fertiliser). 13 Floating storehouses (fertiliser, sulphur). 24 Vessels due, (metal products, chrome ore, sulphur, clay, coal, containers, sunflower seeds). Kerch - One general cargo discharging at berth, 3 under repair/drydock, 1 waiting at anchorage for repairs. Berdiansk - Two vessels loading sunflower seeds at berth, 1 due to load metal products.
